newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Oak Ridge, Tenn..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Oak Ridge, Tenn..

text.p: $7,000,000 Electric System Revenue Bonds, Series 1996 SEPARATE SEALED BIDS will be received until 11:30 a.m.,

(or at such later time and date announced at least forty- eight hours in advance via Munifacts) at the Municipal Building in Oak Ridge, Tennessee (the City'') for the purchase of the City's $16,000,000 General Obligation Public Improvement Bonds, Series 1996 (the
Bonds'') and its $7,000, 000 Electric System Revenue Bonds, Series 1996 (the Electric Bonds'') (collectively, the

Bonds'') at a rate or rates not exceeding seven percent (7.00%) per annum. The Bonds will be dated October 1, 1996 and will mature on March 1, 2000 through March 1, 2014, inclusive, for the Public Improvement Bonds and March 1, 1998 through 2016, inclusive, for the Electric Bonds. No bid for the Public Improvement Bonds will be considered for less than ninety-nine percent (99.00%) of par and accrued

interest. No bid for the Electric Bonds will be considered for less than ninety-eight and nine-tenths percent (98.90%) of par and accrued interest. Unless one or both bids are rejected, the Public Improvement Bonds and the Electric Bonds will be awarded separately on an all or none basis on the sale date to the bidder whose bid results in the lowest true interest rate on the Public Improvement Bonds and the Electric Bonds, respectively. The Bonds are callable March 1, 2003 and thereafter as provided in the Detailed Notice of Sale. The printed Bonds and approving opinions of Bass, Berry &Sims PLC, Knoxville, Tennessee will be furnished at the expense of the City. Additional information, including the PRELIMINARY OFFICIAL STATEMENT, which has been deemed final as of its date by the City except for the omission of pricing and certain other information, and Detailed Notice of Sale, may be obtained from the undersigned at the Oak Ridge Municipal Building, P.O. Box 1, Oak Ridge, Tennessee 37831-0001 or from
